title: Systematic methods were used to search for evidence.

chain_of_thought.step1_locate: Searched Methodology, Literature Search Strategy, Appendices sections for evidence search information
chain_of_thought.step3_reasoning:
The guideline does not contain a dedicated 'Literature Search Strategy' section. The document is structured as a clinical consensus on metformin, with sections on clinical status, mechanisms, dosage, special populations, safety, cardiovascular effects, prevention, and other effects. The document contains a References section with 116 references, but no description of how these references were selected or identified. There is no mention of:
- Electronic databases searched (MEDLINE, EMBASE, etc.)
- Time span of search
- Search terms used
- Complete search strategy provided

The guideline does not provide any information about the systematic search process for evidence, which is required for this item.
